page_title: OSA 1-1 RSO | Osasuna v Real Sociedad 02/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad).
90+6' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
90+4' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' A cross from Nacho Vidal (Osasuna) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
88' Substitution. Andre Silva (Real Sociedad) in, Arsen Zakharyan out.
87' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley well wide of the right post.
87' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
86' Raul (Osasuna) is cautioned by the referee.
84' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Juan Pulido didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
83' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:4.
80' The resulting set piece from Real Sociedad is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
79' Osasuna are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Raul (Osasuna) comes onto the pitch for Ante Budimir.
75' The referee allows time for a substitution. Juan Cruz will be replaced by Nacho Vidal (Osasuna).
75' Substitution. Chimy Avila (Osasuna) on for Aimar Oroz.
75' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Umar Sadiq and he is replaced by Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad).
74' The game has come to an end for Kieran Tierney. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad).
72' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) picks up an injury.
72' Real Sociedad can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
71' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
68' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Juan Pulido blows his whistle for a foul.
66' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Real Sociedad, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
65' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
64' That will be all from Ruben Garcia who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Jon Moncayola (Osasuna).
62' Mikel Merino (Real Sociedad) uses his good position in the penalty area to his advantage and heads the rebound down towards the middle of the goal. The keeper makes a brilliant save, though.

62' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Sergio Herrera is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
61' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Pulido had an easy-decision to make.
58' The referee gives a yellow card to Alejandro Catena (Osasuna).
58' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
56' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
55' Johan Mojica is being substituted because of an injury. Jagoba Arrasate sends Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) on the pitch.
53' Real Sociedad take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
52' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
49' Wonderful movement by Real Sociedad. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
49' Kieran Tierney (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Juan Pulido and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
47' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+5' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
45+2' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
45' 2:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
43' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.

41' 1 - 1 Goal! Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top left corner. Sergio Herrera had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:1.
39' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
38' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Osasuna.
36' Osasuna show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.
34' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
32' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
30' Alex Remiro leaps like a salmon to deny Lucas Torro (Osasuna), whose effort is headed to the top left corner of the goal, but isn't powerful enough to find its way into the back of the net.
28' Real Sociedad failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
24' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
22' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
20' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) offside.
18' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Remiro comes off his line to gather the ball.
16' Ander Barrenetxea just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) replaces him.
15' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
13' Looks like Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
12' Real Sociedad seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
11' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Juan Pulido has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
8' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
6' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
4' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.

2' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Moi Gomez (Osasuna). Ante Budimir plays a through ball and finds Moi Gomez (Osasuna), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalpeeper and fire a close-range shot into the top right corner. It's now 1:0.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Osasuna will have the kick-off.
Juan Pulido will officiate today.
